title: Model catalog: quantization decision templates and validation orchestrator
creator: Sofia Ramirez
description: Create a reusable set of per-model quantization decision templates (FP8 / INT8) and a validation orchestrator that runs calibration + accuracy checks before a quant profile becomes the model catalog default. This ticket defines the template schema, the calibration harness entrypoints, acceptance thresholds, CI gating rules, and an automated rollback policy. Goal: reduce manual model onboarding work by 60% while keeping generation-quality regressions under defined limits.
acceptance_criteria: Template schema v1 implemented and stored in model-catalog/config/quant-templates
Orchestrator that runs calibration, shadow inference, and accuracy checks as a GitHub Action and on internal validation infra
Pass/fail rules codified: metrics, thresholds, and fallback chains
Documentation with example templates for small, medium, and large transformer families
End-to-end demo: attach new quant profile to a catalog entry and verify automated validation run succeeds and marks profile as candidate
technical_decision: We will adopt a dual-path decision model: use FP8-preserving templates for transformer decoder-only models with dedicated per-layer scale heuristics, and conservative INT8 templates for encoder/encoder-decoder architectures. The orchestrator will run both layerwise calibration and end-to-end shadow inference on representative prompt sets. If FP8 shows marginal accuracy loss beyond threshold, the profile remains candidate but is flagged for manual review; if INT8 fails thresholds, the model will revert to float16 default.
calibration_workflow_steps: 1) Fetch model weights and baseline float16 serving config
2) Run per-layer static calibration using representative corpus (1000 batches by family) and generate scale tables
3) Run dynamic range sweep for FP8 candidates to collect overflow rates and per-head variance
4) Generate quantized artifacts for FP8 and INT8 with chosen kernel parameters
5) Run shadow inference on evaluation suite (micro-benchmarks + production-like prompts)
6) Compute accuracy deltas and distributional drift metrics against float16 baseline
7) Upload results to catalog validation dashboard and write status JSON to model-catalog/validation-results/<model-key>.json
validation_metrics: Relative exact-match / BLEU / ROUGE where applicable (task-dependent)
Delta perplexity (mean and 95th percentile) compared to baseline
Token-level KL divergence and sequence-level logprob drift
Instruction-following score (LLM eval harness) on curated prompts
Latency and memory delta under production serving loader
Overflow / NAN incidence for FP8 runs
thresholds_and_guardrails: Max allowed degradation: 2% absolute for task-level metrics OR 5% relative increase in perplexity
No token-level KL > 0.5 on more than 2% of samples
FP8 overflow rate must be < 0.1% during representative runs
Latency improvement must be >= 5% for profile to be considered beneficial
If any safety-relevant prompt fails (policy/guardrail suite), mark profile as blocked
rollout_plan: Step 0: Internal validation in CI (automated) - must pass all hard thresholds
Step 1: Shadow rollout in staging with 5% traffic, collect production-like telemetry for 48 hours
Step 2: Canary at 20% for 7 days with monitoring hooks and auto-rollback on regressions
Step 3: Full catalog default promotion after two successful canaries and manual PM signoff
Fallback: automatic route to float16 or alternative INT8 profile if SLA or quality breaches
ci_gating: Validation Action triggered on PR to model-catalog that touches quant templates
Action must finish within 90 minutes or mark as timed out
Artifacts (scale tables, metrics report) uploaded to artifact store and linked in PR
Merge blocked unless 'validation-status: pass' is present and at least one reviewer approves
monitoring_playbook: Instrumented metrics: rolling accuracy delta, tail latency P99, batch rejection rate, token OOMs
Alert on: accuracy delta breach > threshold for > 1 hour, P99 latency increase > 20%
Automated rollback trigger that flips model catalog default and notifies on-call
Daily digest of active quant profiles and health stats to infra@redwood.com
rollback_policy: Automatic rollback when any hard threshold is breached in production during canary (30-minute evaluation window), plus postmortem within 3 business days. Rollback writes an incident note and attaches validation artifacts. Manual override allowed only by Engineering Manager with written rationale.
open_questions: What is the canonical representative corpus for calibration for multi-lingual models?
Do we store per-model calibration artifacts in S3 or the catalog DB? (cost vs retrieval trade-off)
How to encode model-specific exceptions (e.g., custom layer types) into templates without proliferation of templates
